credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Closeup of Marshall Girard and Georgia O'Keeffe talking to each other on the river in the raft.  Kenny Ross is behind them rowing. This photograph is part of the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe, Marshall Girard, and Guide Kenny Ross
